description: Creates a webhook that POSTs events, including message content, to an HTTPS URL, for trigger ids from cometchat_list_webhook_triggers. Prefer Basic Auth. Returns the triggers actually attached.

approval_code.description: The code the user got after approving this exact change in their browser. Only ever from the user; never make one up or reuse one for different arguments.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change. On a local connection that is enough; on the hosted server this change needs approval_code from the user's browser instead, and confirm is ignored.

id.description: Unique webhook id, e.g. 'backend-sync' (letters, numbers, - and _)

triggers.description: Trigger ids from cometchat_list_webhook_triggers, e.g. message_sent

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives the events

name: cometchat_create_webhook

triggers.description: Triggers attached, as read back from CometChat

title: Create a webhook
